name: Concessional Bus Travel Facility to Women above 60 years of age- Punjab
benefit: Under this scheme, 50% concession in bus fare for women in the State Government buses.
eligibility_rules: All women of 60 years and above residing in the State of Punjab can avail of the benefits under the scheme.
documents_required: Residence Proof (Aadhar Card, Voter Card, Ration Card)
how_to_apply:
Mode: Offline The eligible applicant may contact at village-level AWW for prescribed bus pass performa. Note: All the Child Development Project Officers have been authorized to issue such passes on the production of age and residence proof.
